dtiam_reproduction_boundary: DTIAM uses official BerMol/ESM2 representations and same frozen supervised data/splits, but AutoGluon 1.4 compatibility environment rather than paper 0.5.2.

cold_protocol_validation_fusion.fit_boundary: Per-fold fixed validation-only fusion; no test labels or KIRHub labels used for fitting.

summary.success_rule: Observed AUPRC difference must be positive and both independently reported 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals must exclude zero.
summary.claim_boundary: The secondary route contains ConPLex and cannot establish leakage-free SOTA even if confirmed.

target_to_old_drugs.decision: POST_AUDIT_CANDIDATE_ONLY; requires a new untouched target-centered source before replacement.

old_drug_to_targets.decision: RETAIN_FROZEN_V10; no post-KIRHub refit or automatic blend.

candidate_application.target_to_old_drugs: DTIAM external-augmented post-audit candidate; rank 720 old drugs within each target.
candidate_application.old_drug_to_targets: Frozen leakage-safe V10 retained; rank 384 active targets within each old drug.

directional_old_drug_innovation.claim_boundary: Candidate presentation only. Mutation scores are protein-target-level, not variant-specific binding proof; target-centered replacement requires a new untouched source.

supported_boundary: DTIAM official BerMol and ESM2 representations are retrained on the identical frozen supervised roles; the AutoGluon environment is compatible, not bitwise identical to the paper.
On S3, the same-data DTIAM+BioMaster fusion failed its pre-frozen confirmatory gate; it is not promoted.
On S3, the DTIAM+BioMaster+ConPLex external-augmented route passed both full-OOF and pre-frozen confirmatory comparisons, but source overlap limits the claim.
S5 same-data routed fusion improves over raw DTIAM, while its gain over BioMaster must be interpreted from the drug-cluster bootstrap interval.
The external-augmented route improves over SCOPE on strict source-held KIRHub, but remains statistically indistinguishable from frozen V10 and cannot replace the old-drug head on current evidence.
Target-centric and old-drug-centric deployment heads remain separated.
remaining_sota_gates: Complete all same-data public comparator protocols and require full-fold paired uncertainty before any ranking claim.
Resolve public-checkpoint training-source overlap with additional official same-data retraining or a truly untouched future source.
Obtain prospective biochemical and orthogonal experimental validation; current real experimental result count is zero.
Add variant-specific sequence or structure modeling before making mutation-specific binding claims.
